api/src/models/orm/__init__.py.name: Stored record shapes
api/src/models/orm/__init__.py.description: Declares every kind of record the platform keeps and the fields each one holds.

api/src/models/orm/agent_prompt_history..name: Agent instruction history
api/src/models/orm/agent_prompt_history..description: Keeps each earlier version of an assistant's instructions so a change can be reviewed or undone.

api/src/models/orm/agent_run_flag_conver.name: Run flag discussions
api/src/models/orm/agent_run_flag_conver.description: Stores the back-and-forth where someone discusses and adjusts a flagged assistant run.

api/src/models/orm/agent_run_verdict_his.name: Verdict change history
api/src/models/orm/agent_run_verdict_his.description: Keeps every change to an assistant run's verdict, with who changed it and why.

api/src/models/orm/agent_runs.py.name: Assistant run records
api/src/models/orm/agent_runs.py.description: Holds each assistant run and its individual steps, so progress, cost and outcome can be shown.

api/src/models/orm/agents.py.name: Assistants and chats
api/src/models/orm/agents.py.description: Holds assistants, the tools and roles they may use, and the conversations and messages people have with them.

api/src/models/orm/ai_models.py.name: AI provider settings
api/src/models/orm/ai_models.py.description: Holds each AI provider connection, the model choices built on it, and which model each job uses.

api/src/models/orm/ai_usage.py.name: AI call records
api/src/models/orm/ai_usage.py.description: Records each AI call's usage and its price, so spend can be totalled per run, person or month.

api/src/models/orm/app_embed_secrets.py.name: App embed passwords
api/src/models/orm/app_embed_secrets.py.description: Holds the shared password that proves a request really comes from an app embedded in another website.

api/src/models/orm/app_roles.py.name: App role access
api/src/models/orm/app_roles.py.description: Links each app to the roles allowed to open it.

api/src/models/orm/applications.py.name: App records
api/src/models/orm/applications.py.description: Holds each built app's details, version, build state and who may use it.

api/src/models/orm/artifacts.py.name: Generated files
api/src/models/orm/artifacts.py.description: Holds one record per generated file — document, image or spreadsheet — so it can be downloaded later from anywhere.

api/src/models/orm/audit_archive.py.name: Archived activity days
api/src/models/orm/audit_archive.py.description: Stores each archived day of activity history for an organization after the live log is trimmed.

api/src/models/orm/audit.py.name: Activity log entries
api/src/models/orm/audit.py.description: Records who did what and when, with the details needed to review a change.

api/src/models/orm/authz.py.name: Permission versions
api/src/models/orm/authz.py.description: Tracks when a person's permissions last changed and which older sign-in formats are still in use.

api/src/models/orm/base.py.name: Record base
api/src/models/orm/base.py.description: The common starting point every stored record type builds on.

api/src/models/orm/branding.py.name: Brand appearance
api/src/models/orm/branding.py.description: Holds the platform's shared name, logos and colour settings.

api/src/models/orm/config.py.name: Stored settings
api/src/models/orm/config.py.description: Stores settings and their values, per organization or for the whole platform, including hidden system settings.

api/src/models/orm/custom_claims.py.name: Custom user facts
api/src/models/orm/custom_claims.py.description: Holds named facts about a signed-in person, such as their team or region, that access rules can check.

api/src/models/orm/events.py.name: Incoming events
api/src/models/orm/events.py.description: Holds where events come from — a timetable, an incoming message or a topic — which workflows listen, and every event received.

api/src/models/orm/execution_workers.py.name: Run helper servers
api/src/models/orm/execution_workers.py.description: Tracks each helper server that carries out runs and which runs it took on, so a lost server's work can be closed.

api/src/models/orm/executions.py.name: Workflow runs
api/src/models/orm/executions.py.description: Holds every workflow run with its status, inputs, results and log lines.

api/src/models/orm/external_mcp.py.name: AI tool connections
api/src/models/orm/external_mcp.py.description: Holds outside tool catalogues, each organization's connection to them, their tool lists and each person's sign-in.

api/src/models/orm/file_index.py.name: Workspace file search
api/src/models/orm/file_index.py.description: Indexes workspace and Solution source files so the editor and assistants can search them quickly.

api/src/models/orm/file_metadata.py.name: File details and rules
api/src/models/orm/file_metadata.py.description: Stores details about uploaded files and the access rules attached to folders.

api/src/models/orm/form_embed_secrets.py.name: Form embed passwords
api/src/models/orm/form_embed_secrets.py.description: Holds the shared password proving a form shown on another website is genuinely ours.

api/src/models/orm/form_publications.py.name: Public form links
api/src/models/orm/form_publications.py.description: Holds each shareable public link to a form and whether it is still live.

api/src/models/orm/forms.py.name: Forms and fields
api/src/models/orm/forms.py.description: Holds each form, the fields it asks for, and which roles may open it.

api/src/models/orm/home.py.name: Personal launcher
api/src/models/orm/home.py.description: Holds each person's own launcher layout and favourite shortcuts, and never grants access to anything.

api/src/models/orm/human_sessions.py.name: Staying signed in
api/src/models/orm/human_sessions.py.description: Keeps one record per device a person stays signed in on, so a session can be ended from elsewhere.

api/src/models/orm/integrations.py.name: Outside service links
api/src/models/orm/integrations.py.description: Holds each outside service connection, the settings it needs, and which organization maps to which outside account.

api/src/models/orm/knowledge.py.name: Knowledge library
api/src/models/orm/knowledge.py.description: Holds reference documents and their searchable pieces so assistants and workflows can answer from them.

api/src/models/orm/memory.py.name: Assistant memory
api/src/models/orm/memory.py.description: Stores what assistants remember between conversations, kept private to a person or shared with an organization.

api/src/models/orm/metrics.py.name: Daily totals
api/src/models/orm/metrics.py.description: Holds the daily run, time-saved and storage totals the dashboards chart.

api/src/models/orm/mfa.py.name: Extra sign-in checks
api/src/models/orm/mfa.py.description: Holds each person's second sign-in method, recovery codes, trusted devices and passkeys.

api/src/models/orm/oauth.py.name: Service access passes
api/src/models/orm/oauth.py.description: Holds the configured outside services and the access passes kept for them.

api/src/models/orm/organizations.py.name: Customer organizations
api/src/models/orm/organizations.py.description: Holds each customer organization and its settings.

api/src/models/orm/package_changes.py.name: Package change history
api/src/models/orm/package_changes.py.description: Records each change to the workspace's installed packages so every server ends up with the same set.

api/src/models/orm/pending_capture.py.name: Pending Solution captures
api/src/models/orm/pending_capture.py.description: Queues records marked for capture into a Solution before they are copied into its source.

api/src/models/orm/platform_job_memory_p.name: Job memory learnings
api/src/models/orm/platform_job_memory_p.description: Remembers how much memory each kind of background job actually needed, so the next run is sized correctly.
